domain: All 2693 actual first PVR-account rounds: 1814 MOBILE/add,879 CORE. No rejected candidates/account replays.
hypothesis: PVR strength interacts with high/low directional migration and volume-weighted within-bar closing position. Not prior fixed PVR multipliers, old trend/CP mixture or sector breadth interaction.

features.P: Original PVR_decision only; require finite and matching native reconstruction <=1e-8. No cache replacement.
features.D: Wilder competitive DM14, first14 differences SMA then RMA14, D=(RMAplus-RMAminus)/(sum). Strict zero denominator UNKNOWN. Source/native full prefix; H=L invalidates state. No E0/I/CP reset.
features.C: Existing strict CMF21: sum(CLV*raw shares)/sum(raw shares); CLV=(2C-H-L)/(H-L). Native and raw coordinate consistency, source/path stable21, positive shares, same adjustment and volume factors; H=L and factor/source changes UNKNOWN.
features.D_extra_guard: Native prices match raw*factor, observed/eligible/non-synthetic, H>L; source_kind/path, segment, adjustment_factor,volume_factor change resets RMA; full14 new changes required. Share-factor/source unknown not imputed.
features.scaling: Training-only median and IQR/1.349 for P,D,C; clip z to +/-5. zPD,zPC from product of clipped main z, then training median/IQR1.349 and clip5. Zero robust scale UNKNOWN. Role binary unscaled.

regularization: Summed Bernoulli NLL +0.5*(4*sum(main and role coefficient squared)+16*sum(interaction squared)); unpenalized intercept. Fixed Gaussian prior sd0.5 main/role and0.25 interaction. No class weights/tuning.

clock.fit: First common session monthly, information through preceding close. signal_t>=cut-504 and entry_t+119<cut. Every birth requires full120 potential follow-up, even early exit.2022 no prediction. Source ends2026-05-15.
clock.U: H=120 not fully0-to0 closed is U even if later exit known. Cannot silently drop U, impute loss or treat pW as ultimate win. If any feature-complete mature U in a month, binary final-win model UNKNOWN for that month. If this prevents coherent all-role test, stop rather than change endpoint/model after inspection.

numerics: full design rank7 and condition<1e6; nonfinite, zero robust scale, support failure or optimizer gradient>1e-6 => all controls UNKNOWN. No rescue retune.
evaluation_if_feasible: Same known rows and every fixed year. Date20-session blocks, stocks and stock/I-root clusters; same-day and same-day-role AUC. Fixed same-day ceil(n/2) among originally filled only, tie original priority and sid. Exact original round return mean/winner/loss/payoff. Original return>=20% and original complete60 big label retention; 924 Sep19-Oct8 and2026Q1 separately. Fixed probability bins0/.1/.2/.3/.4/.5/1. No time/threshold search.
restrictions: No account runs, parameter grids, new trading or original strategy edits. Historical/selected-only, non-PIT static universe/industry/source versions and original next-open proxy limits. Not new strategy35%.
